articles.summary: A full trading day of US equities, 354 million top-of-book events, streamed back from QuestDB as Arrow. In strict time order the client peaks at 194 MiB; parallel connections reach 14 Gb/s, using more memory as more results arrive at once. Code, commands and hardware included so you can rerun it.
articles.title: Market data replay for backtesting: a full day of US equities from QuestDB
